verses.en: In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.pt: No SENHOR eu confio; como, pois, tu dizeis à minha alma: Fugi para vossa montanha, como um pássaro?
verses.en_web: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain!”
verses.en_bbe: <For the chief music-maker. Of David.> In the Lord put I my faith; how will you say to my soul, Go in flight like a bird to the mountain?

verses.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.pt: Porque eis que os maus estão armando o arco; eles estão pondo suas flechas na corda, para atirarem às escuras com elas aos corretos de coração.
verses.en_web: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.en_bbe: See, the bows of the evil-doers are bent, they make ready their arrows on the cord, so that they may send them secretly against the upright in heart.

verses.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.pt: Se os fundamentos são destruídos, o que o justo pode fazer?
verses.en_web: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.en_bbe: If the bases are broken down, what is the upright man to do?

verses.en: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.pt: O SENHOR está em seu santo Templo, o trono do SENHOR está nos céus; seus olhos observam com atenção; suas pálpebras provam aos filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is in his holy Temple, the Lord's seat is in heaven; his eyes are watching and testing the children of men.

verses.en: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.pt: O SENHOR prova ao justo; mas sua alma odeia ao perverso e ao que ama a violência.
verses.en_web: Yahweh examines the righteous, but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord puts the upright and the sinner to the test, but he has hate in his soul for the lover of violent acts.

verses.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.pt: Sobre os perversos choverá laços, fogo e enxofre; e o pagamento para seu cálice será vento tempestuoso.
verses.en_web: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.en_bbe: On the evil-doer he will send down fire and flames, and a burning wind; with these will their cup be full.

verses.en: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.pt: Porque o SENHOR é justo, e ama as justiças; seu rosto presta atenção ao que é correto. Salmo de Davi, para o regente, com harpa de oito cordas:
verses.en_web: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is upright; he is a lover of righteousness: the upright will see his face.
